opinions.text: Appeal from the Supreme Court of Ohio. Further consideration of the question of jurisdiction is postponed to the hearing of the case on the merits. Rule 16 (4). The parties are requested to discuss in their briefs and oral arguments this Court’s jurisdiction to consider any questions raised by the possible applicability of In re Murchison, 349 U. S. 133, and In re Oliver, 333 U. S. 257, to the proceedings involved in this case.
